    Downloads

    downloads.Rmd

    Datasets and Templates

    Download these files before the hands-on sessions. Keep them in one local folder so they are easy to upload into MicroHub.

    File Use Description
    microhub-template.csv Template Minimal CSV structure with date, target_group, and value columns.
    bangladesh-preferred.csv Exercises 1-2 Example surveillance time series for upload, visualization, and baseline model exercises.
    chile-target.csv Exercise 3 Second example dataset for comparing Copycat and INFLAenza model behavior.
    example-forecast-output.csv Exercise 4 Reference output for comparing participant downloads to a hub-ready forecast table.

    Data Format

    Column Type Description
    date Date Epidemiological week date. The template uses month/day/year; example datasets use ISO dates.
    target_group Text Population subgroup, location, or reporting stratum such as Overall, Adult, or Pediatric.
    value Number Observed count, rate, admissions, or other target measure for that week.

    Use the same three-column format when preparing local surveillance data.
